P.text: balance_ is less than depositPool.lastUnderlyingBalance in the yield calculation within distributeRewards() in Distributor.sol (approximately line 390), where an unchecked arithmetic subtraction is performed
P.evidence_quote: When balance_ is less than depositPool.lastUnderlyingBalance, this calculation triggers an integer underflow.

I.text: The subtraction must not underflow; Solidity 0.8+ built-in overflow protection should prevent unchecked arithmetic underflow
I.evidence_quote: Since Solidity 0.8+ has built-in overflow protection, the transaction automatically reverts with panic code 0x11.

V.text: Integer underflow causes the transaction to revert with panic code 0x11, resulting in complete protocol DOS and a persistent failure state of the reward distribution system until manual intervention
V.evidence_quote: Complete Protocol DOS: The vulnerability causes total failure of the reward distribution system, affecting all users regardless of their permissions or stake amounts.
